verdict.rationale: PostHog documents official client/server SDKs used to capture events and instrument products ('any SDK', 'PostHog SDKs client-side and server-side' via the AI wizard across 26+ frameworks/languages), plus OpenAPI-based typed SDK client generation for Endpoints, and independent corroboration of straightforward SDK integration (Swift iOS use case). Missing for 10: an explicit enumerated list of all first-party SDK repos/languages and broader independent hands-on reports across multiple SDKs beyond a single anecdote.
